title: Canonical finite reduction comparison for the completed integral tensor
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and a scheme $W$. Work with modules over the completed coefficient sheaf on its small pro-etale site [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Let $M,N$ be arbitrary objects of the ambient integral derived category, $P,Q$ good cochain complexes (K-flat and flat in every degree) [def-a1-flat-term-kflat-complex], and let $\mathsf q$ denote the canonical localization from cochain complexes to the derived category, with isomorphisms $e:\mathsf q(P)\cong M$, $d:\mathsf q(Q)\cong N$. For every $n\geq0$ put $P_n=P\otimes A_{E,n+1}$ and $Q_n=Q\otimes A_{E,n+1}$, computed termwise. Let $T_n=\operatorname{Tot}(P_n\otimes Q_n)$ be the recorded signed tensor complex; use the recorded completed tensor and its representative comparison with the strict Roos complex of the tower $(\operatorname{Res}_m T_m)_m$ [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Define integralTensorFiniteComparison to be the morphism
$$ L\pi_n^*(M\widehat\otimes^L N)\longrightarrow \mathsf q(T_n), $$
where $L\pi_n^*$ is the actual derived integral reduction [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction]. It is the transpose under the normalized scalar-extension/restriction adjunction [lem-weil-derived-scalar-extension-restriction-adjunction] of the following specified composite: apply completed tensor to $(e^{-1},d^{-1})$, then its defining representative comparison, then the $n$th projection of the actual strict Roos complex (the localized mapping-cocone first projection followed by the $n$th product projection), then the inverse exact-restriction factorization identifying that tower term with $\operatorname{Res}_n \mathsf q(T_n)$. Thus the map is fixed by the actual Roos projection and the recorded representative isomorphisms. This defines the comparison for every such $P,Q,e,d,n$, without any boundedness, constructibility, or invertibility-of-$\ell$ hypothesis on $W$, and does not assert that the comparison is invertible.

lean.statement:
def integralTensorFiniteComparison (W : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u})
    (M N : DerivedCategory (integralTowerModules l E W))
    (P Q : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E W).FullSubcategory)
    (e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj ≅ M) (d : DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q.obj ≅ N) (n : ℕ) :
    (scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E W n).obj
        ((integralCompletedTensor l E W).obj (M, N)) ⟶
      DerivedCategory.Q.obj (integralTensorFiniteComplex l E W P.obj Q.obj n)
